description: SqliteLogStorage::insert_entry and insert_entry_and_advance_tips duplicate the log_entries INSERT, the UNIQUE-violation-to-DuplicateEntry translation, and the parent-edge loop verbatim. Extract a private async fn insert_entry_tx(tx, id, entry) -> Result<(), StorageError> and call it from both. This removes ~40 lines of duplication and ensures both paths are always consistent.
title: core: insert_entry and insert_entry_and_advance_tips share identical INSERT + parent-edge code
